topic: Towable generators and where they go
summary: A towable 25 kVA (20 kW) generator is about 11 ft long, 5 ft wide and 5.6 ft tall on its trailer, and weighs about 2,600 lb. Fire codes commonly ask for generators at least 20 ft from tents, refueling at least 20 ft away, and stored fuel at least 50 ft away. Local rules decide; always check with the venue and the fire marshal.
